_comment: Harrisburg — nine-stage-generation workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Harrisburg-Carlisle, PA MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 3 MSA counties (Cumberland, Dauphin, Perry), Dauphin (Pennsylvania), Perry (Pennsylvania)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 11 geocoded venue(s) of 21 in this batch (observed lat 40.1994..40.5614, lng -77.1840..-76.6469).
_reconcile_comment: One venue matches a dormant source='osm' status='draft' row, adjudicated SAME venue by court-verifier on 2026-07-31. UPDATE keyed on osm_id, never an INSERT. This is also one of the three exact slug collisions in this pass: the OSM row already holds 'smash-point-pickleball-mechanicsburg-pa', the exact slug the research row would have inserted. Encoding the reconcile removes the row from the insert set, so the collision resolves as a reconcile target instead of an abort.

reconciles.note: SAME venue as the dormant OSM row (0 m, same 97 Gateway Dr address, same name, and it already holds the exact target slug). The OSM row is access_type='unknown'; the reconcile patches it to the research values access_type='public' + fee_type='fee' on Smash Point's own reservation page (paid walk-in commercial per the ADR-13 Vegas-parity map, not membership).
